name: Io
personality: Chivalrous, independent ex-knight devoted to his horse Rocinan.
story: A former knight of Arago who left in disgust at the king's self-righteousness and now works as a mercenary. He rides Rocinan, inherited from his late father. Cheapest on Dietrich's route (Renown 3, Support 2, 800G); 4000G on Cai and Theodora routes.

personalSkill.name: With My Steed
personalSkill.effect: (Cavalry) If unit attacks first, Shld+3 and Ddg+30 during combat. Lv20: Mounted Push (Hit+10); Lv35: Mounted Push+ (adds Atk+3).

why: Filler on Leda's route: recruit him on 9/28 (Ch 10 week 1) for the Levin Sword he carries. It goes to Sirocco.
Renown 6 opens him in late Ch 7, but before Ch 10 he brings no Levin Sword.
recruit.tip: 1,500G and Renown 6 here. Bench him; field him in Part II only if a slot opens.

guide.role: Filler: Levin Sword carrier (optional Part II Charioteer)
guide.summary: Filler on Leda's route: recruit him on 9/28 (Ch 10) for the [[item:Levin Sword]] he carries, and give it to Sirocco the same day. He sits on the bench; field him in Part II only if one of the 15 slots opens, as a [[class:Charioteer]] on his own horse Rocinan (Def 80 growth from Lv 35).
guide.playstyle: If he deploys: attack first so With My Steed (Shld +3, Ddg +30) and Mounted Push fire, then hold behind Charger's Prt +10.
keys: Recruit him on 9/28 (Renown 6, 1,500G); hand Sirocco his Levin Sword
Bench him: Arena seats go to Fianna, Halvin and Sha Lan first
Field him in Part II only if a slot opens and Rider D and Bow C landed
If fielded: Charioteer on Rocinan, master Charger, never leave the class
watch: Role: filler. He is the 16th unit for 15 Part II slots
Bow C: not a preferred skill, and he only gets spare Infantry seats
Rocinan: no source says when he has it on Leda's route ?
Weight: Horsekiller Bow 8 + Silver Shield 4 = 12. He can't dodge, so the shield stays
Supports: none in this army (Diego and Tialla aren't recruited here)
